restrictions: Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 1 prefix round; both messages are exactly 64 bytes (one chunk, one root block: flags 11, block length 64, counter 0).
Deterministic closed-form construction (our own derivation, proved in proof.md Sections 3-5); no search, no random coins, no heuristic; success probability 1.

Charged time is an exact count for a 174-instruction program on a 256-bit load/store RAM with 16 registers: a 134-instruction straight-line construction (18 loads, 32 stores, 84 ALU operations), then a 40-instruction verification (2 COMP target compressions recomputing both complete hashes; 16 loads, 8 XOR, 7 OR and 1 conditional branch for 256-bit digest equality; 2 loads, 1 XOR and 1 conditional branch for message distinctness; 1 executed halt; 1 never-executed failure halt). Total: 2 target compressions + 171 executed primitive operations + a notional 36-operation charge for the 18-word constant table + a notional 174-operation charge for placing the program text (one per instruction) = 2 + 381/222 = 3.7162 target compressions.

The two verification compressions are the only target compressions evaluated, one root compression per 64-byte message; narrow 32-bit rotations are charged as shift, shift, OR, AND (in six cases the AND is merged into the AND that reduces the following modular sum, which is exact modulo 2^32), and modular reductions as explicit AND masks, as in scripts/reference_operation_costs.py; COMP's state set-up and block/digest I/O are compression internals priced by C = 222.

The output procedure verifies the constructed pair by two complete hash recomputations, a 256-bit digest comparison and a message-distinctness test (word 8 of the two stored messages, which proof.md Section 5 proves always differs), and halts with failure if either check fails; by the theorem neither failure branch is taken, so success probability is 1. Program placement is charged in time although the cost model lists code under memory. proof.md Section 7 tabulates the alternative readings (largest covered log2 1.982, all at most 2.0) and names two stricter combinations that charge compression internals individually and are not covered.
The theorem is uniform over 12 free 32-bit words (2^384 ordered, 2^383 unordered collision pairs); the program fixes them to trivial public values without any selection, so no search is omitted.

The only literals are the BLAKE3 IV, the block length 64, the flags value 11, 0, 1, 0xFFFFFFFF and the shift counts 7, 12, 16, 20, 25; no message word, intermediate value or stored collision is a literal.

time_log2 = 2.0 is log2(3.7162) = 1.8938 rounded up to one decimal, with a margin of 63 primitive operations below 4 units; preprocessing (table 36 + placement 174 = 210 operations) is below one unit, so preprocessing_log2 = 0.
The nominal reference identifier does not assert an improvement over an established attack.
